own_solution.law: Relativistic threshold from invariant mass: (m1+m2)^2 + 2 m2 T = M_f^2, so T = (M_f^2 - (m1+m2)^2)/(2 m2) with M_f = m1 + m2 + Q
assumptions: threshold: products at rest in the CM frame

notes: T = Q(Q + 4m)/(2m) for equal masses: 134.98*3888.06/1876.54 = 279.67 MeV. With an extra 104 MeV of rest energy Q = 238.98: 238.98*3992.06/1876.54 = 508.39 MeV. The earlier reaction and the second station have no path to this reaction. TD012 and TB459 carry 'a small amount' instead of 104 MeV (appear to be number-free variants).
